rules.statement: A buyer who purchases a defined parcel of land with all reasonable and necessary access to the road is not entitled to claim an additional right of way to a specific portion of it, even if that portion was previously separate.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even if lots X and Y consisted of two parcels, it is quite open to an owner to amalgamate them and sell them as one parcel by reference to a plan made for the purpose or by description, and a buyer who purchases the lots as one parcel is not entitled to say, ‘I must have another way of access to a portion of it, which by reason of the configuration of the land I can use as a separate portion’."
